notes: One visitor browsing the wall, exits tile on the left at the end.

Woman in beige jacket who went out about a minute earlier comes back in from the right and walks left with the man in the cap; both later wander back from the left and stand in view.

Door swings open and a man in a dark sweater and a woman with a blond ponytail come in close to the camera and cross left within two tiles; the beige-jacket woman stands half out of frame at the right edge most of the minute, and the man in the cap passes close to the camera once without a clear direction.
Woman in beige jacket stands, then walks off to the left; empty after that apart from a shoe at the bottom right edge.
A visitor is briefly visible at the left edge in the first three tiles; otherwise empty.

Man in cap and brown trousers (a returning visitor from earlier) strides in from the right in tile 2; at the end the man in the maroon jacket and the woman with the blond ponytail leave through the door, which swings into view.

Man in teal cap and brown trousers walks out at the right edge in tiles 1-2; the man in the grey jacket steps into view close to the camera at tile 6 from an unclear direction (treated as moving within the room) and the couple later come back from the left.

Woman in beige drifts out at the right edge for about 6 seconds and is back at the edge, then sits in the chair; man in brown trousers crosses from the left and goes out of view on the right, but a brown trouser leg stays at the bottom right edge, so he is probably standing just out of frame rather than gone; grey-jacket man blocks the right side for several tiles.

Woman sits in the chair all minute; a crossed leg in brown trousers at the bottom right edge shows the man from earlier is seated just out of frame, so some right-edge exits nearby were not door exits.

Man in tan beanie stands close to the camera handing a yellow item to the man in brown trousers, blocking the right edge for the first third, then leaves through the door, which stays swung open for about 20 seconds before closing.
Man in grey jacket wanders around with his phone and is half out at the right edge in the last tile; others move off to the left.

Seated woman gets up and goes out of view by tile 9 but is seen still inside at the start of the next strip, so she is not counted as leaving here. The door swings open briefly while both men are in view close to the camera (no one seen passing); the two men step out of view to the right, then come back and work at the door in the last eight tiles, propping it open.

Door is held open for the first 28 seconds with the two men standing at it; the woman in the beige jacket walks out past it in tiles 2-3 and a young man in black with a phone comes in behind the glass; the door is then pulled shut (one swing) and starts to open again in the last tile.

The beige-jacket woman is back inside close to the camera from the first tile; she came in on the door opening seen in the last tile of the previous strip (only a hand showed there), so her return is counted here as an arrival and reentry. The young man in black walks toward the camera and out of the bottom of the frame at tile 11, direction unclear, not counted.
Woman browses and the young man in black sits with his phone at the lower left; nobody crosses the right edge.
People visible only at the left edge in the first seven tiles; empty afterwards.
Empty until the last four tiles, when the woman in the beige jacket walks in from the left toward the wall.

Door opens around tiles 7-10 and a family comes in: a girl in a purple jacket, a woman in a black coat, a small child, and a second adult first seen through the glass then bending at the left of tile 10 (that fourth person is the least certain). The door opens again at tile 29 and a figure in navy with a tan hat, probably the beanie man from earlier, crosses left.
A group gathers close to the camera eating and chatting, coming in from the left and below the frame; they block parts of the right edge in the second half but nobody is seen crossing it.

Six or more people stand chatting close to the camera; the man in the blue jacket covers the right edge for most of the top row, so a quick pass behind him could be missed, but no one is seen crossing and the door leaf never shows.

Small crowd milling close to the camera; the man in the grey jacket stands in front of the right edge for much of the first two rows and the beanie man hovers at the edge with his phone in the last row; no crossing or door swing seen, but one could be hidden.

People circulate between the wall and the camera (beanie man, a man in a camo fleece, the young man in black, a child in purple); several pass close to the lens and briefly cover the right edge, and the beige-jacket woman stands half in frame at it, but no one is seen entering or leaving there.

Woman in beige, young man in black and the grey-jacket man talk right at the right edge; the grey-jacket man steps out of view there around tile 18 with no door swing seen, so he may just be standing outside the frame; the woman stays half visible at the edge.

Woman in beige jacket walks back in from the right edge at tile 24 after about 40 seconds out of view; in the last three tiles the door swings open and the beanie man walks to it, still partly in view at the final tile, so his exit is left for the next strip (04440.jpg, in the next chunk). Young man in black walks toward the camera and out of the bottom of the frame at tile 22, not counted.
